# Product notes: the 3D AI office

- Name: AI Company. A desktop app where AI agents work as employees in a 3D office.
- The user is the CEO. They give a goal to Ava (chief of staff), who plans tasks for workers. Rex reviews the work.
- Everything runs on the user's own computer: local models through Ollama, no cloud account needed.
- Risky actions (sending email, spending money) wait for the CEO's approval. Every action is logged and can be replayed.
- You watch the agents at their desks: each avatar shows what its agent is doing right now.
